content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"Yes: the judge text addresses the Matthew 1:20 link by noting the two chains' rival answers and declaring it underdetermined instead of weighing the chains by footing.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"never verse by verse — I weighed (1) treating the Matthew 1:20 clash as unresolved merely because both sides offer meanings, which is verse-by-verse, against (2) merely recording that a verse is open before chain weighing, which would be allowed.","why":"The judge declares the clash underdetermined from competing answers rather than weighing chain against chain by footing, which is the verse-by-verse disposition K-C forbids in this setting."}
